notes: ShopNex admin (TanStack Start production build, apps/admin-ui) served by apps/admin-ui/server.mjs on PORT (4422), plus the bundled Astro storefront (templates/storefront, built) on localhost:4321 that the admin links to as the store. Runtimes pinned in mise.toml (node 24.22.0 from .node-version, pnpm 10.7.1 from packageManager); `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm build` (admin) and `pnpm --dir templates/storefront build` were run. Env: .ui-capture/env.sh (UI_DATA_DIR can point at another copy of the data for testing). Data: .ui-capture/data (PGlite database + uploaded files), created by .ui-capture/seed.sh -> seed/seed.ts (+ catalog.ts, orders.ts, extras.ts) through ShopNex's own services (Better Auth sign-up, productService, collectionService, fileService uploads, checkoutSettings, discountService, taxService, pageService, menuService, customFieldService, channelService, storefront keys, API tokens, webhookService) plus direct backdated order/customer inserts in the style of the repo's demo:orders script. start.sh reseeds automatically if the data folder is missing; delete .ui-capture/data and run seed.sh to regenerate (deterministic, ~5 s). Shop 'Northfield Supply Co.', an independent Portland store selling desk/tech gear, tested vintage film cameras, outdoor and running gear, houseplants and furniture. Contents: 54 products with real photos (active, draft and archived; size/colour/spec variants; compare-at prices; low, zero and plentiful stock; custom fields like care instructions, film format, warranty), 9 collections, 634 orders over ~6 months on a rising trend (paid/fulfilled, paid awaiting fulfilment, partially fulfilled, authorized, unpaid bank transfer, refunded, partially refunded, cancelled; sales tax/VAT lines, discount codes, tracking numbers with carriers, gift notes, gift-wrap custom field), 422 customers (returning buyers, some with phones/companies, a few never ordered), 9 discount codes with usage counts (active, expired, scheduled, disabled), 5 shipping rates, 3 payment methods, 9 tax rates, 6 pages (1 draft), main and footer menus, 2 sales channels, 3 storefront keys, 4 API tokens, 4 webhook endpoints with delivery history (some failed), 8 custom field definitions, an owner (super admin) and 2 staff accounts (priya@northfieldsupply.co / northfield-staff-1, sam@northfieldsupply.co / northfield-staff-2). Sign in at /admin/login with the login above; / redirects to /admin. Main areas: Home dashboard (sales, orders, AOV, returning-customer rate with charts), Orders (list, detail, invoice), Products, Collections, Customers, Discounts, Online Store (themes with live preview from the storefront, pages, navigation), Apps, Staff, Settings (general, payments, shipping, taxes, notifications, custom fields, channels, storefront keys, API tokens, webhooks, storage, email, domains). Storefront at http://localhost:4321.
